title: (feat) O3-5413: Add bill refunds
body:

- [x] My work includes tests or is validated by existing tests.

## Summary

- Adds a full bill refunds workflow: cashiers request refunds on PAID/PARTIALLY_REFUNDED bills, admins approve or reject, cashiers then process approved refunds to COMPLETED
- Supports bill-level and line-item-scoped refunds with cumulative cap enforcement; at most one active refund per scope at a time
- Adds an admin Refund Requests page (mirroring the Discount Requests page), a cashier-facing Request Refund modal, and an admin Review Bill Refunds modal with a receipt rail showing approved and completed refund totals
- Fixes three billing calculation bugs found during review: REJECTED refunds were incorrectly reducing `remainingRefundable`; COMPLETED refunds were not deducted from line-item remaining (double-refund risk); and `bill.refunds?.filter().reduce()` crashed when `refunds` was undefined
